task.description: Root-cause confirmation for GH-755/ISS-0695. Verify the diagnosis in the GH-755 body matches the actual code.

context.diagnosis_given: AppendResult returned by Store.append() has its .record.metadata heap-allocated by duplicateFromParams() (src/event_store/store.zig:1368). Since the result is captured with _ =, that allocation is never freed.

result.summary: Confirmed root cause. Reading src/event_store/store.zig line 1368: `const owned_metadata = allocator.dupe(u8, metadata) catch "";` — even when params.metadata = null, the `orelse "{}"` fallback provides "{}" which gets duplicated → still heap allocation. Mirrors GH-753/ISS-0691 precedent exactly. Fix pattern: capture result, defer-free metadata with `len > 0` guard. No production code change required.
